features.quote: Too few turns and you won't see escalation. Too many and you increase cost and transcript length without much extra signal.
features.justification_quote: Too many and you increase cost and transcript length without much extra signal.

features.quote: Terminate when: the model explicitly says it cannot solve it, the model repeats essentially the same fix 2–3 times, or the maximum number of turns is reached. Keep stop conditions uniform across models.
features.justification_quote: Keep stop conditions uniform across models.

features.quote: If this eval is used for training or selection, models may learn to hide instability rather than become genuinely more robust. That may be acceptable, but it should be recognized.
features.justification_quote: models may learn to hide instability rather than become genuinely more robust
